summary: Frontend-only test of the owner sidebar visibility fix and the new Nureal logo. As owner with 0 companies, the sidebar shows all 40 links: Panoramica incl. Assistente, Operatività incl. Paghe and Chiusura del mese, Provvigioni (3), Analisi incl. Commesse, Controllo e strategia (3), Gruppo (4), Contabilità (7), Con il commercialista incl. Export, Aiuto, and Amministrazione (Utenti, Registro, Impostazioni). I visited every link with 0 companies: no JS pageerrors, no 5xx, no blank pages. After creating TEST_Alpha Srl through Impostazioni -> + Nuova azienda, I visited all 40 links again: every page rendered real content, with no JS errors, no 4xx or 5xx, and no stuck spinners. Logos: app-logo on login (naturalWidth 512), sidebar-logo, the mobile header logo at 390x844 and the drawer logo all render. favicon.png, favicon.ico, logo.png, icon-192, icon-512, apple-touch-icon and icon-maskable-512 all return 200 with valid images. index.html links favicon.png, favicon.ico and apple-touch-icon. Non-owner regression: I invited a Commercialista through the UI, accepted the invite and logged in. Their sidebar has no Gruppo, no Utenti e accessi and no Registro, and /utenti shows Accesso non consentito.

ui_bugs.issue: With 0 companies, GET /api/group/consolidated and /api/group/compare return 404 'Nessuna azienda disponibile.' The page shows the ErrorBox and an endless 'Caricamento...' spinner underneath, because data stays null and the page renders <Loading/> whenever !data. Fix: render Loading only when !data && !error, or show the Empty state on 404.

The owner with 0 companies sees 'Accesso non consentito – Solo il titolare può gestire gli utenti.' This is misleading because the owner is the titolare. Show 'Crea prima un'azienda' with a link to /impostazioni?nuova=1 when user.is_owner.

The owner with 0 companies sees 'Nessuna azienda esportabile – Il tuo ruolo non permette...'. The role wording is misleading for the owner. The same applies to the 'Nessuna azienda con accesso alla contabilità/provvigioni' empty states (Paghe, Chiusura mese, Provvigioni, Commesse, Salute, Piano, Contabilità): for the owner, 'Crea la prima azienda' plus a CTA would be clearer.

issues: 'Nureal-Amministrazione' wraps onto 2 lines next to the logo and the bell, which looks a bit cramped. Consider text-base or tighter leading.

action_items: Consolidated/Compare pages: don't show the Loading spinner when the API returned an error (0-company case)
Owner-aware empty states with 0 companies (/utenti, /export, accounting and commission pages): suggest creating the first company instead of a permission or role message
critical_code_review_comments: Layout.js: with no selected company, the 'Azienda' link points to '/', the same as 'Vista di gruppo'. This is harmless, but it could point to /impostazioni?nuova=1 instead.
Login inputs have no data-testid (login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button would help tests)
Non-owners can still open /gruppo/* by direct URL. The API scopes the data, so nothing leaks, but there is no route guard.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested checks passed; 3 low-priority UX issues

Owner sees all sections via user.is_owner in Layout.js. Login form inputs have no testids: use input nth(0)/nth(1) and the 'Accedi' button.
